notes.title: Vulcan Sacrifice is now FREE
notes.notes:
Hey Steamers,

After a long while on the steam store, I have made Vulcan Sacrifice free. Before now, it was a dollar.

It is a small platformer game with some obvious flaws. It was made during a few separate weeks of game jamming and the game itself is/was just about as awesome as I could make it with the time I had. The story, art and music have always been really special to me. I hope you can overlook the flaws and enjoy it. 

The level with the wizard skeletons is especially flawed in its difficulty. In the 'Options' screen, you'll find a Patreon box for entering a cheat code. The code enchants Bart Waffle's axe to make it deal double damage. This is a HUGE help by the time you get to the wizards. The code is [spoiler] PIZZASHARK [/spoiler]

A sincere thank you to all the friends that supported my Patreon in the past. It is closed down now, but thank you still. I am still out and about in the world making games when I can :)

Thanks everyone,
- Tartle Wizard
